newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dlr closes firmer in market reversal.
newsitem.headline: Canada dlr closes firmer in market reversal.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar firmed in fairly thin trading on Monday to close at C$1.3547 (US$0.7382) from Friday's close at (US$0.7360), making up for some of the strength lost during Friday's sell-off in financial markets, dealers said. * They said American market players who sold Canada to buy U.S. dollars on Friday began buying Canada again today.
The Toronto Stock Exchange closed up 96.44 points at 5,906.50 on Monday. And Canada's 30-year benchmark bond rose C$1.20 to C$112.25 to yield 6.979 percent.
The reversal in the markets prompted American investors who sold Canada to buy U.S. dollars on Friday to change their positions, dealers said.
But the currency met heavy resistance at the C$1.3545 (US$0.7383) level, dealers said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.1487 marks from Friday's close at 1.1374 marks and moved up slightly to 83.65 yen from 83.32 yen.
